title: Output-cost recurrence bounds
statement: For every natural number $d$, the randomized recursive NAND tree's maximum expected query cost on inputs with output $+1$ is at most the recursively defined false cost at level $d$, and its corresponding maximum on inputs with output $-1$ is at most the recursively defined true cost at level $d$.
